Name: Flippin' Shadows
Overview:
Light-hearted competition that's great for friends or family, and a great party game.

Watch the shadow of a moving object cast upon a curtain, and try to choose from 4 possible items quicker than opponents. Double-point and Lightning rounds spice things up so anyone could have the most points when the flipping is done!

Play with up to 4 players or CPU opponents, in multiple unlockable game modes.
